content: Written 2026-10-07 19:06, self-approved (user 19:0x: win B, no excuses; supervisor 96747 19:0x agrees the ray-band model is TSDF's measurement model). Real row 4 RB = code 7ba58f8, stage B only, resumed from real_row4v9/checkpoint_a.pt (= v7's A; A with RB is GaME's published loss exactly, no earlier session). Flags: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --no-closed-background --ray-band --dataset real --resume --sessions ab. No S3 (--session-keyframes), no S4, no N1.

Each stored keyframe is a depth measurement of the first surface on its rays. Current session: GaME's colour + depth loss (Eq. 4-6, unchanged; the map is being fitted to it). Earlier session: the ray model of TSDF fusion (Curless & Levoy 1996; free space before d - tau, surface within [d - tau, d + tau], unknown beyond) as a dead-zone L1 on GaME's rendered depth: relu(|D - d| - tau), which also penalises an uncovered pixel (D < d when alpha < 1); no colour (a measurement is used once: its appearance is already in the carried Gaussians). Depth supervision weighted by each measurement's own uncertainty: DS-NeRF (Deng et al. CVPR 2022); free-space + near-surface band losses: Azinovic et al. CVPR 2022, Co-SLAM CVPR 2023 (supervisor's pointers, to be checked).

tau per earlier session and 0.5 m range bin = sigma_from_histogram (P37 estimator: 1.4826 x median |residual|, RTS-smoothed over bins) of |d - D/alpha| of that session's keyframes against the current map at pixels with alpha >= GaME's min_opacity 0.3 within GaME's depth_change_threshold 0.3 m; updated at every keyframe optimisation from each keyframe's latest render. Smoke at B start: A's tau 1.85 1.47 1.42 2.41 2.44 3.26 5.41 8.11 8.69 cm (0-4.5 m). No new constants.

eval_row.sh unchanged (official chain). Diagnostics after it: tsdf_export --views a / --views b of checkpoint_b (GAME_CONFIG set) + views_attribution.py + memory_extra_origin.py, as for v9 (supervisor 19:0x asks for the per-view split).
smoke_rb_real (B 150 frames from the A checkpoint): no error; per-session tau tables filled (209 A keyframes, 158 histograms after 300 iterations).
v10's C stopped at frame ~1600 (reruns later). B ~ v4/v7 timing (~20-25 min, peak ~6-8 GB), eval ~5 min, two exports ~3 min. Disk 351 GB used inside (cleanup 18:5x).

B G1 median TSDF: P above v9's 90.88 from fewer A-view-only artifacts (v9: 2972 memory samples in neither A reference nor A export, A views only) and no double walls from A pulling within its band; R near v9's 93.87 or higher; F1 92.8-93.8, uncertain. Risk (supervisor): the far-range A walls deeper than tau (offset 12-13 cm vs tau ~8-9 cm at 3.5-4.5 m) are still pulled by A; unobserved retention at or above v9's 72.4 (A views keep supervising unobserved memory).

Sources checked by the supervisor on the originals: Azinovic CVPR'22 Eq. 3 (free-space term between camera and band, truncation term inside, weights beyond the first truncation region set to zero) = the ray band; its lambdas (0.1/10/6e3) are hand-set and not used here (RB weight 1, GaME's own scale). GaME arXiv 2506.06909 has Eq. 1-10, section 4.3 unnumbered; Eq. 11-15 do not exist.

(a) tau is the robust scale of the earlier session's residuals against the current map (counted within GaME's 0.3 m window, so far bins are underestimated), not an upper bound of the inter-session error: by construction about a third of its pixels lie outside the band and keep pulling. (b) Earlier sessions' keyframes take part in every keyframe optimisation (GaME's sampling) although their information is already in the carried Gaussians: intentional, because the official readout renders the map through them, so the map must stay consistent with them; only the band (geometry outside it) is used, not their colour -- the analogue of the TSDF volume that keeps the old measurements' surface while new frames update it.

Curless & Levoy 1996 not checked on the original (cited from memory). Proposed per-session signed bias beta(q) from residuals against the current map: NO-GO from existing data (analysis/old_kf_residuals_v9.json): signed median per 0.5 m bin +3.3 +2.7 +2.2 +0.2 -0.3 -1.0 -2.5 -4.8 -4.9 cm (0-4.5 m), negative at 3-4.5 m where the same-wall offset (A deeper) would be positive -> dominated by see-through of the map from A's views; per keyframe median -2.6/+0.7/+4.7 cm and slope -5/+0.3/+22 % per m (q10/50/90): no single per-session table. A sensor bias between sessions would have to be measured against B's own measurements (its present surface; P41 / Teichman RSS'13 type self-calibration), not against the map.
